images.title: 原图式微缩全景
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE landscape 16:9 full-bleed game runtime-screen concept for the 3D cozy Jiangnan farm 我有一片田. The attached image is a REFERENCE for the overall small rural courtyard, layered garden / house / water arrangement and handcrafted miniature spatial depth. It is NOT an edit target. Remove ALL advertising typography, calligraphy, logos, slogans, banners and framing from the reference. No concept sheet, no collage, no side panels. A convincing 3D world the player could gently orbit with the camera.
A complete compact Chinese rural homestead, one modest grey-tiled plaster-and-timber house with visible facade and roof, a clearly readable vegetable garden with stone paths and low bamboo fences, a short water bank and small stone bridge, a few restrained ceramic and timber props. The house must remain fully inside the frame and must NOT dominate the frame. Crops should stay individually readable; field occupies about one third of screen rather than a close-up filling the whole frame. Keep foreground crops and paths sharp; atmospheric softness only in distant scenery. No humans, no animals, no floating terrain pedestal, no palace, no European barn or windmill. These are atmosphere and camera explorations, not a fixed asset-count specification.
Minimal quiet HUD only: bottom-center three compact ivory buttons labelled exactly “播种” “浇水” “收获”; upper-left small basket icon and “0”; upper-right small sun or moon icon and time. Leave ample space between HUD and garden. No other text, captions, visible variant number or watermark.
CAMERA: classic wide three-quarter diagonal view very close to the supplied reference composition, looking down approximately 30 degrees, camera pulled BACK to include the entire homestead and garden, 50 mm-like restrained perspective. The cottage sits upper-right, garden center-front, small gate left, canal and bridge right. Clearly show vertical wall heights and the depth from foreground bank to back garden. Not top-down, not a front-facing flat garden grid.
STYLE: finely handcrafted miniature, warm natural matte plaster, weathered timber and terracotta, carefully grouped roof tiles, rich but controlled leaf forms. Soft warm late-afternoon sun, sage and olive greens, warm stone, quiet teal water. A gentle hazy Jiangnan river landscape recedes behind the farm. Comparable charm and dimensionality to the original, reduced clutter and much less blur. HUD time “16:30”.

images.title: 点击田块后的聚焦
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Generate ONE 16:9 full-bleed game runtime concept showing the FOCUSED CAMERA STATE of the exact farm in the attached reference. The input is the farm overview, not an aesthetic moodboard. Imagine the player has clicked the highlighted leafy-green FIELD PATCH near the center-left front. Move the same 3D camera closer and aim at that patch, lowering its downward angle to roughly 25 degrees. The chosen field should now occupy about 40 percent of the screen, with individual leafy plants clearly separated and easy to click. Keep the enclosing paths, nearby radish bed to the left/back and wheat bed to the right, and more distant small farmhouse to the back/right in their original relative world arrangement. Do not simply crop and enlarge the 2D image: re-render the perspective from a closer, slightly lower 3D camera, preserving the same farm identity, house, materials and atmosphere. Buildings and neighbouring fields may naturally be partly outside the closer framing. No giant front-facing twelve-square grid.
Keep the original warm handcrafted miniature style, creamy plaster, grey tiles, wood, jade water, detailed but readable foliage; soft morning sunlight. Focus stays sharp across the selected field, immediate paths and nearby interactive areas. An understated ivory corner outline marks the selected field; no bright neon border. One plant may have a small corner hover indicator.
HUD: lower center three compact ivory buttons with exact Chinese labels “播种” “浇水” “收获”. Upper-left small button “全景”, then basket icon and “0”. Upper-right sun icon and “08:30”. No other text, arrows, title, poster, logos, captions, inset, before/after layout or collage. No people, no animals. This is one clean plausible in-game view for tending the selected field, with the larger farm still perceptible around it.
images.review: 以 02 为参考生成聚焦图；保持大体布局，但局部株数、建筑与道具存在生成漂移，不当作同一三维场景的精确相机截图。

images.title: 青绿绘本风
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one landscape 16:9 plausible 3D cozy farming game screen, a wide OVERVIEW of a larger fictional old Jiangnan homestead. Use a very distinctive PAINTERLY 3D ART DIRECTION: real dimensional meshes and clear perspective with hand-painted broad brush-like color shapes, simplified chunky rounded volumes, matte warm plaster and wooden materials. A serene Chinese celadon / blue-green landscape palette: offwhite buildings, dark slate roofs, dark aged wood, jade-green waterways and layered moss / teal foliage, small warm ochre accents. NOT photorealistic, NOT intricately detailed miniature photography, NOT flat 2D watercolor, NOT a concept art board. Visible planes gently shaded, stylized low-detail surface texture, all depth still genuinely 3D.
CAMERA: a wide three-quarter perspective view looking down about 32 degrees. Clearly see front and side facades, roof planes, plant heights and winding paths. The full farm spreads across most of the frame, individual rectangular field patches look relatively small in the overall setting. Around eight spacious patches with several broad-leaf plants each, clean stone paths between them. One complete modest grey-tiled cottage in the upper-left background occupies less than one sixth of the frame, a low bamboo fence, a few clay jars, a stream to the right and small stone footbridge. The field arrangement should be organic around paths rather than a giant regular twelve-cell checkerboard. Subtle misty willow-covered hills FAR behind the farm, soft luminous overcast morning. Crops in playable area sharp and not veiled in mist. Calm, spacious, refined and slightly storybook-like. No people, no animals, no fantasy floating base, no giant temple, no western architecture, no 2D flattened perspective.
HUD is minimal and understated: three small bottom-center ivory buttons with labels exactly “播种” “浇水” “收获”, small basket “0” upper left and sun icon “09:00” upper right. No other text, logos, titles, borders, inset, split screen or collage. Output only the single full game screen.
